themes.title: Right-wing leaders criticize abortion and feminist policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right leaders across multiple countries continue to target abortion rights and feminist policies, framing them as threats to traditional values. This theme persists as a unifying rhetorical strategy, with leaders like Javier Milei and Giorgia Meloni reinforcing anti-abortion stances while facing backlash from opposition groups.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei blames feminism and abortion for Argentina's declining birthrate, calling it a costly mistake.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni criticizes feminist movements for focusing on trivial issues like gendered language, arguing they have fought the wrong battles.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish President Nawrocki's policies reflect ongoing opposition to progressive feminist agendas, aligning with traditionalist values.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox challenges Spain's gender violence laws, replacing 'gender violence' with 'domestic violence' in social housing criteria, sparking legal action from the Equality Ministry.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Anti-immigration policies remain a dominant theme in right-wing and far-right discourse, with parties leveraging border crises to justify stricter controls. This theme is particularly intense in Europe, where leaders like Giorgia Meloni and parties like Vox and AfD frame immigration as an existential threat, while in the U.S., Trump's administration continues to prioritize restrictive measures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni defends Italy's strict migration policies, citing 80,000 rejected asylum requests and emphasizing the EU's new migration pact as a turning point.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands immediate deportations of migrants in Ceuta, accusing the Spanish government of enabling an 'invasion' and collaborating with human traffickers.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD proposes stricter immigration controls, including deportations and restrictions on asylum seekers, ahead of Saxony-Anhalt's state election.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration intensifies sanctions on Iran and plans new measures to curb immigration, including deportations to dangerous regions.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK proposes a £500m fund to support British expats forced to return due to potential welfare restrictions, targeting immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN targets immigration in overseas territories, proposing stricter controls and linking migration to broader societal issues.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties continue to make electoral gains across Europe, with the AfD leading polls in Germany's Saxony-Anhalt and making inroads in other regions. This theme reflects a broader trend of rising far-right influence, driven by voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a focus on issues like immigration, economic insecurity, and national sovereignty.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments are increasingly targeting social programs as part of broader fiscal debates, justifying cuts as necessary for economic stability. This theme is evident in Argentina, the U.S., and Hungary, where leaders like Javier Milei and Donald Trump frame austerity measures as essential to reducing deficits and promoting growth, often sparking public backlash.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei implements severe austerity measures, including cuts to social programs, while privatizing state assets and deregulating the economy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration proposes cuts to welfare programs, including SNAP, and rolls back environmental regulations to reduce government spending.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's Tisza government reduces political salaries and cuts costs, while facing criticism for prioritizing fiscal consolidation over social welfare.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK proposes cutting £21 billion from disability benefits (PIP), arguing it is unsustainable and unfair to younger generations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox criticizes Spain's government for failing to address rising household debt and economic insecurity, advocating for fiscal restraint.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Internal divisions and leadership challenges are destabilizing right-wing parties across multiple countries, as factions clash over policy direction, electoral strategies, and personal rivalries. This theme is particularly pronounced in Italy's Lega, Poland's PiS, and the U.S. Republican Party, where leaders like Matteo Salvini, Jarosław Kaczyński, and Donald Trump face growing dissent from within their own ranks.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS suffers a major split as former PM Morawiecki forms a new faction, deepening fragmentation in Poland's right-wing camp.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei faces growing dissent within his party, with allies like Karina Milei consolidating power and challenging his leadership.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK experiences internal turmoil as key figures resign and criticize Nigel Farage's leadership, threatening party unity.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump-backed candidates face skepticism from his base, while internal GOP divisions persist over loyalty and policy direction.
